svg.text: Synthesis Stage — As-of Aligned Multi-Channel Signal Composition
Causal multi-resolution trend + cross-market disagreement + event-level sentiment → calibrated point forecast with selective abstention
causal multi-resolution encoder · state-conditioned band routing
trailing z-score per channel · cross-sectional dispersion
TSemb + LLMemb · volatility-aware attention · regression head
All components are causal in time (only past ≤ decision_time). The disagreement proxy and sentiment scores are also written to Stage 2’s provenance graph.
